title: Meta brings its Muse AI assistant directly into Instagram DMs
summary: The new integration gets rid of the need for users to toggle between Instagram and the Muse app when they want to interact with the AI agent.
reason: TechCrunch media report of a non-model product rollout: Meta integrating its Muse AI assistant into Instagram DMs. Not a new model/major version/capability, and no official owner announcement link, so it fits the industry rule's non-model product launch via reputable media.
